entries.title: Job 36:1
segments: Elihu went on and said,

entries.title: Job 36:2
segments: Wait for me a little, and I will show you that [there are] yet words for God.

entries.title: Job 36:3
segments: I will bring my knowledge from afar, and I will credit righteousness to my Maker.

entries.title: Job 36:4
segments: For truly my words [are] not false; He who is perfect in knowledge [is] with you.

entries.title: Job 36:5
segments: Behold, God [is] mighty, and does not despise; [He is] mighty in strength of heart.

entries.title: Job 36:6
segments: He will not keep alive one who is wicked, but gives right to the afflicted.

entries.title: Job 36:7
segments: He withdraws not His eyes from the righteous, but [they are] like kings on the throne; yes, [He] causes them to sit forever, and they are very high.

entries.title: Job 36:8
segments: And if they [are] bound in chains, and are held in cords of affliction,

entries.title: Job 36:9
segments: then He shows them their work, and their sins, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

entries.title: Job 36:10
segments: He also opens their ears to teaching, and commands that they return from iniquity.

entries.title: Job 36:11
segments: If they obey and serve Him, they shall spend their days in blessedness, and their years in pleasures.

entries.title: Job 36:12
segments: But if they do not obey, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

entries.title: Job 36:13
segments: But the ungodly in heart heap up wrath; they cry not when He binds them.

entries.title: Job 36:14
segments: Their soul dies in youth, and their life [ends] among the sodomites.

entries.title: Job 36:15
segments: He delivers the poor in his affliction, and opens their ears by oppression.

entries.title: Job 36:16
segments: And He also would have lured you from the mouth of distress [to] a wide place not cramped; and the setting of your table [would be] full of fatness.

entries.title: Job 36:17
segments: But you have fulfilled the judgment of the wicked; judgment and justice take hold;

entries.title: Job 36:18
segments: For [beware] wrath, that He not lure you with [His] scorn; then a great ransom cannot turn you aside.

entries.title: Job 36:19
segments: [If] your cry for help is set in order, then [it will] not [be]. in distress, but with all the forces of strength.

entries.title: Job 36:20
segments: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

entries.title: Job 36:21
segments: Beware, do not turn to iniquity; for this you have chosen rather than affliction.

entries.title: Job 36:22
segments: Behold, God is exalted in His power; who teaches like Him?

entries.title: Job 36:23
segments: Who has appointed Him His way; or who can say, You have done wrong?

entries.title: Job 36:24
segments: Remember that you magnify His work of which men have sung;

entries.title: Job 36:25
segments: every man has seen it; man may see [it] afar off.

entries.title: Job 36:26
segments: Behold, God [is] great, and we do not know; the number of His years cannot be searched out.

entries.title: Job 36:27
segments: For He draws up the drops of water; they distill rain into mist,

entries.title: Job 36:28
segments: which the clouds pour down [and] drop on man plentifully.

entries.title: Job 36:29
segments: Also can [any] understand the spreading of the clouds, or the crashing of His canopy?

entries.title: Job 36:30
segments: Behold, He spreads His light on it, and He covers the bottom of the sea.

entries.title: Job 36:31
segments: For by them He judges the people; He gives plenty of food.

entries.title: Job 36:32
segments: He covers His hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark;

entries.title: Job 36:33
segments: its thunder declares concerning Him, and the cattle, concerning what is coming.
